description.value: Kappo Marta is a Japanese restaurant on Bay Street in Victoria's Fernwood neighbourhood offering traditional kappo-style counter dining, where chefs prepare food directly in front of seated guests. The kappo format — meaning 'to slice and cook' — is an elite culinary style similar to kaiseki but less formal, creating an intimate choreography between chef and diner. The menu spans teishoku, donburi, and broader Japanese cuisine categories.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the OSM address (1600 Bay Street, Victoria BC V8R 2B6) and phone number ((250) 590-2449), validating the OSM contact data. No cyclist-specific amenities — bike parking, water refill, washrooms, takeout, or Wi-Fi — are mentioned anywhere on the website. A notable anomaly: the website body text references 'at KAPPO in Cascais', which is a city in Portugal, suggesting the website content may be partially copied from or shared with a sister location, though the contact block clearly identifies this location as Victoria, BC.
concerns: Website body text references 'at KAPPO in Cascais' (Cascais is a city in Portugal), suggesting the narrative content may have been copied or adapted from a related restaurant elsewhere. The contact block correctly identifies this location as Victoria, BC, so this appears to be a content/copy issue rather than a phantom listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating Japanese restaurant in Victoria with confirmed address and phone; suitable for inclusion as a Food & Drink stop for touring cyclists.
